propositions: The DC transport must implement TicketTransport plus SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, and SupportsAbsenceProbe roles, built atop pycontribs/jira as an opt-in [jira-datacenter] extra with lazy imports to preserve dependency-free rebar imports

Every TicketTransport method returns raw payload shapes (dicts) that existing mappers consume, never jira.JIRA objects, verified through the shared _jira_shape_contract assertions against both unit fakes and live execution
Configuration must fail loudly on ConfigError (malformed [tool.rebar.jira]) rather than degrading to env-only, with JIRA_PAT read only from environment and JIRA_URL/JIRA_PROJECT from typed config

TLS certificate verification is never disabled (verify is never False); non-https base_url is rejected unless allow_insecure=true is explicitly set; ca_bundle configures internal CAs; resolved_statuses configures the absence probe's resolved-status set

Retry logic mirrors acli_rest exactly: retries requests.ConnectionError, requests.Timeout, and builtin TimeoutError with 2s/5s backoff; HTTP errors never retried; assignee faults raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError

All 13 TicketTransport and related methods (create, get, update, transition, label, search, link, comment, probe) must pass live tests against the J5 harness with postconditions verified on the server; NameIdentity user-search resolver must return authoritative identity for real users and raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError for unknown ones
